what: Server-side timings of the agentfeed-mezo gateway (the same product on Mezo testnet), read from a read-only copy of its sqlite ledger on the VPS (payments.total_ms and payments.upstream_ms); the copy was deleted afterwards. 67 settled calls, 2026-10-25T15:32:45Z to 15:56:00Z. 'own' = total_ms minus upstream_ms, i.e. everything except the AgentFeed fetch (verification, permit and transferFrom, response).

permit.note: gasless for the agent, like agentfeed-near: the gateway settles and pays gas

transfer.note: the agent had already sent the transfer and paid its own gas before the request; the gateway only verified it
